name: English
tagline: Cat Petting Timer for Apple Watch
headline: An app for petting your cat?
intro: A few minutes together deserve a place in your activity log. LuCat saves those moments for each cat, from your wrist to your iPhone.
how: Choose a cat on Apple Watch, tap Start, and enjoy your time together. Tap End to save the session and sync it to your paired iPhone. Browse your calendar to revisit which cat you spent time with, for how long, and the interaction patterns recorded.
cats: Add your cats, take a profile photo, and open it for a closer look. Keep separate histories for every cat, including Piggy, Little Black, Little Yellow, and Little Orange.
weight: Log weigh-ins for growing kittens or cats managing their weight. Review each cat’s weight changes on a chart.
reminders: Set reminders and a daily goal such as three minutes or three sessions. Reminder notifications can cycle through your cats’ profile pictures.
motion: Review movement timelines and estimated interaction intensity derived from wrist motion. These are motion estimates, not direct measurements of force or pressure on your cat.
postLabel: Read the original post on X
devices: For iPhone, iPad, and Apple Watch
